Verses.Text: When your days have been completed and you rest with your ancestors, I will raise up your offspring after you, sprung from your loins, and I will establish his kingdom.
Your house and your kingdom are firm forever before me; your throne shall be firmly established forever.
David said to Nathan, I have sinned against the LORD. Nathan answered David: The LORD has forgiven your sin; you shall not die.
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, my deliverer, my God, my rock of refuge.
